theorems.name: Submission.imc_isRectifiableTriple_of_eventually_mem
theorems.statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (M : ℕ → Set (Eucl N)) (θ : ℕ → Eucl N → ℝ) (ξ : ℕ → Eucl N → NVector (Eucl N) k) (M₀ : Set (Eucl N)) (θ₀ : Eucl N → ℝ) (ξ₀ : Eucl N → NVector (Eucl N) k), (∀ j, IsRectifiableTriple (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k (M j) (θ j) (ξ j)) → (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ M j, 1 ≤ θ j x) → NullMeasurableSet M₀ (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)) → (∀ x ∈ M₀, 1 ≤ θ₀ x) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl N), IsCompact K → IntegrableOn θ₀ (M₀ ∩ K) (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N))) → (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)).restrict M₀), (∀ᶠ j in atTop, x ∈ M j) ∧ Tendsto (fun j => ξ j x) atTop (𝓝 (ξ₀ x))) → IsRectifiableTriple (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k M₀ θ₀ ξ₀
